messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1829876543 - Detected spike in kv_cache size + batch latency on prod-east. Error rate increased 0.9% -> 4.7%. Paging kicking in. Pager: emma oncall.

emma oncall: seeing huge tail latencies, p95 -> 2.1s, p99 -> 18s. Customers A/B reporting 503s. I'm paged, looking.

devon_sre: on it. Looks like continuous-batching backlog for mixed short/long requests. Scheduler starving small requests while big ones hog KV slots.

liu_runtime: confirming: KV cache mem spike + eviction storm after a quantized model rollout earlier (deploy ~00:12 UTC). Continuous batching config 'max_batch_size=256' + 'max_batch_time_ms=80' causing large batches forming. Paging thrash when KV misses.

sam_platform: rolling revert for recent runtime flags? which PR number?

emma oncall: pulling up deploys... rolled model xg-2q around 00:12 UTC. I can rollback batch config via `/deploy-tool set-config prod batch.max_size 64`. Need approval.

nina_support: customers noticing increased latencies: customer-kappa and customer-zeta. Support tickets #6421 #6423.

devon_sre: recommend immediate mitigation: 1) reduce max_batch_size to 64 2) enable per-request fairness throttling (short-request-priority) 3) temporarily increase KV retention to avoid evictions. I'll prepare commands.

liu_runtime: prepared hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/4789 - changes batching defaults + fairness token bucket. Can we hotpatch without full deploy? yes via dynamic flags.

emma oncall: applying dynamic flags now: `/infractl flags set prod batch.max_size 64 && /infractl flags set prod batch.fairness true`

opsbot: Command accepted. Flags queued. Rolling to prod-east nodes.

emma oncall: flags rolled to 60% of nodes, monitoring.

devon_sre: monitoring metrics: p99 dropping from 18s -> 6s on flagged nodes. Error rate trending down. But KV eviction still high on some hosts.

liu_runtime: pushing KV retention bump: `/infractl mem set prod kv.retention_seconds 7200` to avoid immediate thrash.

opsbot: KV retention change applied to prod-east.

sam_platform: starting graceful restart of two overloaded batch scheduler processes on prod-east-12/14 to clear stuck batches.

carol_sales: any customer comms? need ETA. Sales asks for short note.

nina_support: drafting: "We experienced intermittent latency and errors for embeddings/generation in prod-east between 00:10-00:40 UTC due to a batching regression. Mitigation in progress. We'll update shortly." Will post to affected customers.

devon_sre: confirm: no data loss, only latency/errors. If runway holds, plan full deploy of hotfix PR in 30m.

emma oncall: handing off to liu_runtime for night coverage at 01:15 UTC. Please continue watch, escalate if error rate >1% for >5min. Handoff: we've reduced batch size, enabled fairness, bumped retention, restarted schedulers. Next steps: full hotfix deploy and root-cause RCA.

liu_runtime: ack. I'll keep monitoring logs and follow up with postmortem. Added runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/ops/runbooks/kv-batching

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, impact=partial, severity=sev2, incident_channel=#incidents. Ticket INC-2026-214 created.

nina_support: posting customer note now. :thumbsup: \n
liu_runtime: leaving final note -> will apply PR 4789 to prod in 20m if metrics stable.

(End of thread)
